State College Cycling Club Tuesday Ride

State College, PA · Road

State College Cycling Club Tuesday Ride is a road group ride in State College, PA. It rolls every Tuesday at 6:00 pm. Pace: a through C speed groups (12 to 20+ mph).

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: a through C speed groups (12 to 20+ mph). It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @statecollegecyclingclub the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the State College Cycling Club Tuesday Ride group ride

Road rides for a range of abilities with speed groups from C (12–14 mph) up to A. Start location changes by week of the month. New riders are told to pick an easier group than they think.
